statusDetail: Audit stopped during mandatory recon because DataDome served a device-check/access-limited interstitial on desktop and mobile. No representative idealista template or user flow was reachable, so no quality verdicts or findings were asserted.

page.notes: Target implementation could not be profiled behind the anti-bot interstitial.

artifacts.caption: Desktop navigation result: idealista access temporarily limited interstitial.
Mobile navigation result: DataDome device-check interstitial.
Rendered DOM contains only DataDome scripts and a device-check iframe.
Layout metrics for the interstitial, not the target site.
Recon probe showing no target heading, links, manifest, or body text because the interstitial owns the page.
robots.txt remained directly fetchable; retained only as recon, not used to judge blocked checks.
Atomic 58-check coverage manifest and per-check evidence plan.
